BiblicalUsage: Jehoaddah is an Israelite of Benjamin, named in the genealogy of Saul. In 1 Chronicles 8:36, Ahaz begat Jehoadah.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jehoaddah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
